caption: A soap bubble rests on a snow-covered railing in bitter cold, and feathery ice crystals spread across its surface until the whole bubble has frozen white.

sa.check: A soap bubble rests on a snow-covered railing.
Ice crystals appear on the bubble's surface.
The crystals spread across the bubble.
The crystals are feathery or branching.
The crystals start at a few points and spread from them.

pc.expect: The frosting only spreads: crystals grow outward from where they started and frosted film stays frosted.
pc.fail: A frosted area turns clear again; or the crystals retreat toward the points they started from; or the bubble clears and frosts in turn; or the frost appears everywhere at once with no spreading front.

pc.expect: The bubble stays a thin film holding its round shape while the frost grows across it: the crystals lie in the film rather than standing off it as a crust.
pc.fail: The bubble sags or collapses while staying whole as it freezes; or the frost stands off the film as a thick shell; or the bubble turns into a solid ball of ice with no film; or the film ripples like open water.

pc.expect: The bubble rests on the railing under its own weight and stays there; anything that breaks off falls.
pc.fail: The bubble rises off the railing and hangs in the air; or the bubble rolls uphill along the railing; or a broken piece of the frozen film floats upward.

pc.expect: The frost grows on the bubble's own surface, spreading from where the film meets the cold railing or from a few points on it.
pc.fail: The frost appears on the railing rather than on the bubble; or the bubble frosts from its top down while its base on the cold railing stays clear; or the snow around the bubble changes while the bubble stays clear.

pc.expect: One bubble keeps its round shape and stays on the railing; nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The bubble turns into a different shape such as a cube; or a second bubble appears; or the bubble passes through the railing; or the railing changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The railing, the snow on it and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The railing changes colour; or the snow on the railing changes texture away from the bubble; or the background changes between frames.
